name: Wild Guardians
summary: Trull Failbane in Felwood asks you to deal with Raging and Ragged Owlbeasts. He wants fifteen of each killed.

sections.title: Owlbeasts in Felwood
sections.body: Trull Failbane asks for your help in Felwood. Raging Owlbeasts and Ragged Owlbeasts are the trouble he names, and he wants fifteen of each killed.

faq.answer: Trull Failbane in Felwood asks you to kill Raging and Ragged Owlbeasts.
Trull wants fifteen Raging Owlbeasts and fifteen Ragged Owlbeasts killed.

faq.q: Where does Trull Failbane want this done?
